name: Breaching A Dam
overview: Scripture uses the imagery of breaching a dam to illustrate how strife begins and spreads, likening it to the release of water that quickly causes damage if not restrained (Proverbs 17:14). The wise man exercises discretion by deferring anger and passing over transgressions, thereby preventing conflict from escalating (Proverbs 19:11). True peace is valued above abundance accompanied by strife, emphasizing the importance of quietness and reconciliation (Proverbs 17:1). Christ-centered forgiveness is essential, as believers are called to forgive others so that God may forgive their own trespasses, breaking the cycle of contention and restoring harmony (Mark 11:25).
